parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of a display, primarily made of glass with a thin protective layer. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and other visual content. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen is fixed in position and does not move relative to the base during normal operation.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It connects the screen to the surface it stands on.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, ensuring it remains upright and stable during use.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move, though it may allow for limited tilt or rotation depending on the design.
